notes.title: v1.0.2. Update
notes.notes:
What’s new:

- Double dice now gives player extra ATK+ bonus
- Hex info will now display how many turns since flag is captured
- Once activated action hex will disappear for three turns.
- If only two opponents are in the match, they will start on the opposing board sides. 
- You can centre the camera to your units with 1 2 3 4 keys.
- Info about combat bonuses is now visible before combat starts.

notes.title: Launch!
notes.notes:
What’s new:
- 7 unique single player missions
- single player skirmish mode with deathmatch and capture the flag modes
- online multiplayer lobby
- Steam achievements

Please look forward to long term post-launch support and the new content. We will continue to build and expand this game based on your feedback. We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: v0.50 Update - online multiplayer now available!
notes.notes:
Now you can fight in online multiplayer battles! Up to four players can matchmake into online battle to increase their rank.

Another gameplay related change is move points distribution. Now you can share move points between all your units and not just one mech. For example, that gives you an option to move your units in formation.

And another change is that combat now takes place on the board instead of separate screen.

Other upcoming features:
- better combat animations
- custom multiplayer mode
- new single player modes
- single player missions
- more music
- better sound effects and more

notes.title: Welcome to Armored Freedom!
notes.notes:
Let’s begin with a brief overview of features you can expect in future updates.
- Right now, you can battle AI bots in a single player mode to increase your rank, but online play is where the main effort will go. The main goal is to provide a stable and competitive multiplayer experience as soon as possible.
- Various terrain effects/modifiers.
- New game modes: capture the flag and boss battles.
- Animation improvements.
- Achievements and trading cards.
- Unlockables, such as new maps and mechs.
- Deeper avatar and mech customization.
- Localization to other languages.

This Early Access game is a work in progress. We welcome and appreciate all your suggestions, comments, and bug reports in the community hub discussions. 

Entrust your freedom to heavy armor!
